title: Empanada Stuffed Sausage German Sausage
description: A traditional German sausage with an Argentinian twist, using empanada filling and served with a side of speck.
instructions: 1. Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
2. Slice the onion and cook until translucent.
3. Add the garlic and cook for an additional minute.
4. Add the sliced speck and cook until crispy.
5. Add the empanada filling and cook until heated through.
6. Slice the Argentinian sausage and add to the skillet.
7. Cook for an additional 5 minutes, until the sausage is browned.
8. Season with salt, black pepper, and thyme.
9. Serve the sausage mixture on a bun or roll, topped with mustard if desired.
